name: memhub-staging
description: MemHub staging for Codex: team memory and Rulebook hooks. Use the setup skill to verify the active hook route and credential. Repository shell commands in projectless tasks must include an explicit cd prefix when the host omits workdir. Spec workflows: spec-work guides implementation, spec-check freshly reviews changes, and spec-maintain offers local/cloud bootstrap and reviewable Git or Brain proposals through the shared spec entry point.
